title.zh: 生长限制分割及后继组成
title.en: Growth constrains fragmentation and successor composition

claim.zh: 实际生长得到的两种同组成连接图限制一边断裂后的后继；精确连通证书和共同准备计算保留断裂规律改变造成的排序反转。
claim.en: Two actually grown graphs with matched composition constrain successors after one-edge removal; exact connectivity certificates and common-preparation calculations retain a cut-law ranking reversal.

hypotheses.zh: 给定局部生长、分化、事件序列、消耗支持的断键、催化对应和共同八槽准备。
hypotheses.en: Supplied local growth, differentiation, event sequence, support-consuming cut, catalytic correspondence and common eight-slot preparation.

correspondence.zh: 后继由实际剩余连接导出；原链状案例与新接合链的端点结构经 Lean 核对，但形成机制不同。
correspondence.en: Successors derive from actual remaining connections; Lean compares the old chain endpoint with the new assembled chain, while their formation mechanisms differ.

detail.zh: 复用 Becoming.Readout.no_judge_of_merged：组成相同的两个生长图切割回报不同，故亲代摘要的任何函数都不同时给出二者（PreparationCorrespondence.no_parent_summary_predictor_by_core）。
detail.en: Reuses Becoming.Readout.no_judge_of_merged: the two grown graphs have the same parent summary and different mean cut returns, so no function of the summary gives both (PreparationCorrespondence.no_parent_summary_predictor_by_core).

Reuses Cuts.attached_link_separates and Cuts.joined_cut_unchanged_iff: the bonds read both ways are Cuts.Links, division keeps them grown by attachment, so every grown bond separates its ends and the reinforced chain's bypass is the join law (PreparationCorrespondence.bond_cut_separates, aggregate_cut_unchanged_iff).
detail.zh: 复用 Cuts.attached_link_separates 与 Cuts.joined_cut_unchanged_iff：双向读的键即 Cuts.Links，分裂使它们保持依附式生长，所以每条生长出的键都分开其两端，加固链的绕行即连接规律。
额外维持边可阻止分裂；原准备产出未重建原发育图，不能独自迭代为增长率。
detail.en: An additional retention edge can prevent fragmentation; the old preparation output did not rebuild its developmental graph and cannot by itself be iterated as a growth rate.

limitations.zh: 额外维持边可阻止分裂；原准备产出未重建原发育图，不能独自迭代为增长率。
limitations.en: An additional retention edge can prevent fragmentation; the old preparation output did not rebuild its developmental graph and cannot by itself be iterated as a growth rate.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 回执绑定实际源码；推论有效性与生物对应分列。
validation_scope.en: The cited Lean receipt binds the actual source; inference validity and biological correspondence remain distinct.

next_delta.zh: 复用已完成分割；新的链状接续只覆盖一个结构类，变化的生成规律及真实断裂仍待说明。
next_delta.en: Reuse completed fragmentation; the new chain continuation covers one structural class, leaving changing generative laws and actual fracture to explain.
